classification_summary.planning_total: B1+B3+B4+B5+B6+B7 gross 72-126 engineering person-days; overlap-adjusted program planning range approximately 60-105 person-days. B2 is an additional 12-20 person-days only if the user re-scopes online discovery into the critical path.

bottom_line: The accepted repository is beyond a storage-only MVP but is not the original full research product. The current manual/lightweight/simple-draft slice covers intake, resumable local retrieval, citation-safe QA and basic drafting. The remaining approved product work is chiefly canonical single-paper integration, official code evidence, typed graph/comparison, advanced synthesis/reproduction, real corpus qualification and cross-namespace productization; online discovery/versioning is deliberately deferred until a new user scope decision.
